description: This file defines a React component named ToastProvider that manages toast notifications within an application. It provides context-based API functions for triggering success, error, and info toasts, with auto-dismiss behavior, and renders toast UI elements.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string based on current timestamp and a random component.

methods.name: useToast
methods.description: Custom hook providing toast API for components to trigger toasts within a ToastProvider context.
